summary: Gauzy Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a September 8, 2026 press release announcing a 1-for-20 reverse share split effective 11:59 p.m. ET September 10, 2026, with split-adjusted trading beginning September 11, 2026 under the existing symbol GAUZ and new CUSIP M4757U114. Outstanding shares fall from 22,862,718 to roughly 1,143,135 post-split, with fractional shares rounded down. The board action, disclosed in an August 17, 2026 proxy statement, aims to regain compliance with Nasdaq's $1.00 minimum bid price rule; outstanding notes, options, warrants and RSUs adjust ratably. This is a routine capital-structure maintenance action, not a special situation.
